messages.author: 6a50f393e991ef35
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Cant install Bioconductor with Revolution R Open 8.0.1 beta3
parts:
Hi Stephen,
I'm getting a similar but different error in a clean Ubuntu 14.04 docker container I'm using for testing:

> source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "rt") :
  cannot open file '/usr/lib64/RRO-8.0.1/R-3.1.2/lib/R/etc/repositories': No such file or directory

I have a feeling that there is a issue because the BioC install script is making some assumptions about where things are located. I'm running another test right now, and hope to have a workaround soon.

Thanks for your report,
Chris Mosetick

messages.author: 6a50f393e991ef35
messages.subject: Re: [RRO] Cant install Bioconductor with Revolution R Open 8.0.1 beta3
parts:
Hi Stephen,
Please add a `repositories` file to your RRO install. We are still investigating why RRO for Ubuntu is not putting this file in the right place. We have a bug report for this in the works. 

As a one-off work around for now please do the following in your Ubuntu installation:

As user root create this file with your text editor or using wget:

cd /usr/lib64/RRO-8.0.2/R-3.1.2/lib/R/etc/
wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RevolutionAnalytics/RRO/master/R-src/etc/repositories
R
source("http://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite()

Thank you,
Chris Mosetick
